folder: 3 Mistakes That Shorten Your Cat's Life

shots.vo_line: Three mistakes almost every owner makes with our dental health.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat stays standing in place, slowly opens his eyes and wags his raised paw gently as if starting to explain, with a smug little head tilt. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Mistake 1. Thinking we're fine because we don't complain.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat gestures with his raised paw like a teacher making a point, mouth moving as if talking and ears twitching, while the lamp light glows softly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Cats don't show pain.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sits perfectly still, blinks slowly once and twitches his whiskers, breathing gently while his copper eyes stay fixed on the camera. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: It's our survival instinct. Showing weakness
shots.motion_prompt: The cat walks slowly forward a couple of steps, glancing nervously sideways, while the tiger shadow on the wall prowls along beside him at the same pace. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: in the wild means being someone's next dinner.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat stays crouched low, eyes darting nervously and ears flattening, while the glowing predator eyes in the leaves behind blink slowly and mist drifts through the foliage. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: So when our mouth hurts, we keep staring out of the window and sleeping like nothing's wrong. But
shots.motion_prompt: The cat finishes a big slow yawn, closes his mouth and settles his head back down on the cushion, while rain streaks run down the window behind. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: inside, the plaque's been spreading for months.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his mouth wide open, eyes widening in shock, while the tiny glowing green bacteria wriggle and pulse on the plaque-covered teeth. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: The inflammation's already there.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle motion: the open mouth trembles slightly, the swollen red gums glisten and pulse faintly, and the tongue shifts a little. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: More than 80% of us
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sits still looking out of the window, tail swishing slowly and ears turning, while raindrops trickle down the glass and city lights flicker. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: have dental disease before the age of 3,
shots.motion_prompt: The tabby winces and slowly rubs its cheek with its paw, jaw trembling slightly in pain as its eyes squint. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: and hardly any owners
shots.motion_prompt: The woman's eyes widen as she reads down the long bill, her hands tightening on the paper, while the cat on the table behind breathes slowly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: find out until the vet hands them the bill
shots.motion_prompt: The woman stares at the bill in shock, her mouth falling further open as her eyes scan down the paper, curls swaying slightly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: for £1,500 of surgery under general anaesthetic.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman slowly lifts the bill in disbelief, her hand pressed to her mouth, while the sleeping cat on the table breathes gently and the drip bag sways slightly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Mistake 2.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat stays standing in place, shrugging his raised front paws with an exasperated head shake and an eye roll, mouth moving as if talking. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Thinking biscuits
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle motion: the jaw closes slowly on the biscuit, a few crumbs falling away, as the drip of saliva stretches and wobbles from the tooth. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: and plastic toys are enough.
shots.motion_prompt: The bored tabby lets out a slow sigh, rolling its eyes and resting its chin on its paw, tail flicking lazily, while the balls stay still on the floor. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: In the wild, we chew bark, bones and roots.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat gnaws the branch contentedly, jaw working slowly with eyes closed in bliss, while autumn leaves drift down through the sunlight. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: That friction scrapes off the plaque
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle motion: the side teeth grind slowly into the rough bark, small wood flakes crumbling away, as the cat's eye blinks contentedly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: and keeps our teeth healthy. It's what nature built us for.
shots.motion_prompt: The tabby settles deeper into its bed, smiling with a slow contented blink and a gentle purring breath, ears twitching softly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: But in your flat, there's only soft biscuits and synthetic toys.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman gently jiggles the toy towards the cat, who taps at it half-heartedly with one paw and then lowers it, unimpressed. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Our brains tune them out in minutes. It's not that we're fussy,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat lies flat with his chin on the rug, slowly blinking and letting out a bored sigh, ignoring the toy mouse that stays still in front of his nose. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: it's that they don't give us what we need.
shots.motion_prompt: The tabby sits still among the toys, eyes half closed, slowly turning its head away with an unimpressed huff and a single tail flick. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And the plaque problem doesn't stay in the mouth.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle motion: the swollen red gum pulses faintly around the tartar-caked tooth, which glistens as the jaw trembles slightly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Bacteria travel through the blood to the kidneys, the heart and the liver.
shots.motion_prompt: The glowing teal bacteria drift and tumble slowly along the bloodstream as red blood cells flow past, their tiny spikes wriggling. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Organs that wear down in silence, and decide how long you'll get to have me.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman hugs the cat tighter, rocking gently with her eyes closed, while the faint red glow inside his body pulses slowly like a heartbeat. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Mistake 3. Waiting for something to go wrong before acting.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his raised paw steady and looks up seriously, blinking once, whiskers twitching as if he is about to speak. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: I won't tell you it hurts.
shots.motion_prompt: The tabby walks slowly a few steps down the hallway towards the bright doorway, tail swaying, its long shadow gliding along the wall. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: I show it another way.
shots.motion_prompt: The tabby looks up at the camera with big innocent eyes, blinking slowly and tilting its head, while the torn toy lies still beside it. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: I chew your cables and your plastic bags. I get more anxious,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat chews on the tangle of black cables, jaw working and eyes darting guiltily sideways, the cables shifting slightly in his mouth. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and sometimes I need to wake you up at 3 in the morning.
shots.motion_prompt: In slow motion the cat drifts only slightly forward through the air, paws spread, staying in the upper part of the frame, while the woman in bed flinches back with hands raised. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And there comes a point where it's too late to prevent it.
shots.motion_prompt: The tabby sits still looking out at the rain, tail swishing slowly and ears turning, while raindrops trickle down the glass. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: But there's something we actually love.
shots.motion_prompt: The tabby stretches luxuriously in the pool of sunlight, paws flexing and its contented smile widening, as dust motes drift in the warm light. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: It's Meow Mouth. A powder for our dinner, made with brewer's yeast
shots.motion_prompt: The cat smiles happily with a slow blink and a gentle head tilt, golden sparkles twinkling softly around him. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: and a bacon flavour, so we eat it by instinct. Then it comes back out through our saliva,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat eats happily from the bowl with eyes closed, head bobbing gently as he chews. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and the zinc and plant enzymes
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle motion: the glistening golden saliva wave washes slowly across the teeth, tiny sparkles drifting and swirling, the lips trembling slightly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: break down the build-up on our teeth
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle motion: yellow plaque flakes lift off the teeth and crumble slowly into drifting golden sparkles as the gums brighten to a healthy pink. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: and freshen our breath.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman nuzzles the cat gently, swaying slightly, while he leans into her cheek with a contented smile and a slow purring breath. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: It's not another treat that's gone in two seconds. It works on our teeth every time we eat,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat stays standing in place and waves his paw dismissively at the dusty bags, turning his head away with a scornful look, while the bags stay still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: with no fights over the toothbrush,
shots.motion_prompt: The woman scrubs gently at the cat's teeth as he squirms and paddles his paws while staying held in her arms, foam dripping and the tap running. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and no bills that take your breath away.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman slowly shakes her head in disbelief and catches her breath, shoulders dropping as the long bill trembles in her hands. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Just happier cats
shots.motion_prompt: Natural, subtle real-camera motion: the cat eats from the bowl, head moving gently as it chews, ears twitching. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: who clean our teeth while we eat.
shots.motion_prompt: Natural, subtle real-camera motion: the cat licks its lips and looks around contentedly while the woman smiles and laughs softly, holding the bowl steady. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: It's made with senior and sensitive cats in mind, and it's vet recommended.
shots.motion_prompt: Natural, subtle real-camera motion: the cat sleeps peacefully, its side rising and falling with slow breaths, one ear twitching. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Thousands of us are already eating it.
shots.motion_prompt: Natural, subtle real-camera motion: in each of the four photos the cat keeps eating with small head movements; the grid borders stay fixed. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: I'll leave the link below, so you can finally
shots.motion_prompt: Natural, subtle real-camera motion: the cat slowly stretches its paw down, then pauses mid-air without touching the tub, ears forward. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: stop feeling guilty, and give your cat the care they deserve.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman smiles dreamily with her chin on her hand while the cat beside her blinks slowly and purrs. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.
